keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: no Cliopatria row exists for this principality. It is the 1375 Cliopatria shape of the Despotate of Arta minus the Arta half (see despotate-of-arta_1359) and minus Nafpaktos (a 15 km circle at 21.83 E 38.39 N). Nafpaktos is not part of the 1359-1374 principality: the Nafpaktos page has it Serbian 'briefly ... during the 1350s', Catalan from 1361 ('In 1361 the town was captured by the Catalans of the Duchy of Athens') and Shpata's only in 1376 or 1377, and the Gjin Bua Shpata page says 'In 1376 or 1377, Shpata conquered Nafpaktos' and lists 'Nafpaktos or "Lepanto" (1377-78; 1380-?)' as a separate holding from 'Despot of Angelokastron and Lepanto 1359-1374'. The 'Lepanto' of the infobox title is therefore a label, not a dated holding; the name is kept because the infobox uses it. [Reviewer eu-05-f fix, applied 2026-10-19.] The line between the halves is my reading; the page gives no area.

ledger.note: 1359: Gjin Bua Shpata's Albanians hold Angelokastron and Aetolia. The page: he led raids 'into Epirus, Acarnania and Aetolia in 1358', was 'recognized in early 1360s as a Despot of Aetolia and Acarnania', and its infobox table gives 'Angelokastron and Lepanto' as 1359-1374; in 1360 Simeon Uros 'decided to leave the areas of Arta and Aetolia to Shpata and Losha'. The state's own boundary against Arta is not given by any page. Nafpaktos is not in the drawn land: it was Catalan from 1361 (Nafpaktos page) and Shpata took it only in 1376 or 1377 (despotate-of-arta ledger).

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for it; the Despotate of Arta infobox lists 'Despotate of Angelokastron and Lepanto' as a predecessor and the text says that in the late 1360s 'two principalities existed, one at Arta and one at Angelokastron', united in 1374. Written as a direct counterpart of despotate-of-arta (brief section 10); slug 'despotate-of-angelokastron-and-lepanto' is free. No page has an article of its own for it (wikipedia null). Whether it was ever fully separate from Arta (the pages speak of a joint Losha-Shpata movement) is not settled; the split here follows the footnote of the Peter Losha page. Lepanto: see the Despotate of Arta dossier's note on the 1376/77 date. Gazetteer names needed: Angelokastron (the fortress is drawn as a guessed circle in the Arta dossier), Aetolia, Acarnania.

REPAIR 2026-10-19 (reviewer eu-05-f, finding 1). Nafpaktos (15 km circle at 21.83 E 38.39 N) removed from every region of this dossier (keyframe, found, merge and dissolve events, predecessor and successor land, Achelous war zone): the Nafpaktos page gives it to Serbia in the 1350s, to the Catalans from 1361 and to Shpata in 1376 or 1377, and the Gjin Bua Shpata page dates its conquest the same way. The name 'Angelokastron and Lepanto' is kept (the infobox label). The 1374 merge now hands the same land to despotate-of-arta, which gains Nafpaktos from catalan-company in 1376. Remaining thin: Serbian recognition (Simeon Uros, early 1360s) not written as a vassal pair (page not opened in this repair).
